question: Which Kannada short-story collection became the first-ever to win the International Booker Prize in 2025?

options.text: The Many Lives of Syeda X

solution:
The correct answer is __**Heart Lamp: Selected Stories**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Heart Lamp: Selected Stories** is a renowned Kannada short-story collection that achieved a historic milestone in 2025 by being the **first-ever Kannada work to win the International Booker Prize**.
 
• The collection is celebrated for its profound exploration of **human emotions, cultural nuances, and socio-political commentary** through the medium of short stories.
 
• It was authored by a **prominent Kannada writer** who has been recognized for their significant contributions to Indian literature and the Kannada language.
 
• The International Booker Prize is awarded annually for a book translated into English, and **Heart Lamp: Selected Stories** was lauded for both its original narrative and the **quality of its translation**, which made it accessible to a global audience.
 
• This achievement not only brought international recognition to Kannada literature but also spotlighted **regional Indian languages** on the world stage.
